paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.23% on average, with DAX strongest (+0.77%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-0.82%). Brent crude changed +1.00% to 101.59. Gold changed -0.52% to 4,165.2002. Bitcoin changed -1.98% to 84,090.2266. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.269%, a relative move of -0.79%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-5.60%) and Lazard (+3.06%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: McKesson and CD&R strike $5.8bn deal to buy infusion services provider (FT Markets). Acquisition of Option Care Health is latest buyout of a healthcare services company trading below historic valuation multiples Deals and capital markets: NextEra’s $67bn Dominion takeover faces political backlash in Virginia (FT World). Rising power bills and concerns about monopoly power prompt officials to intervene in deal Central banks and macro: French central bank head warns country at risk of being ‘strangled by interest rates’ (FT Markets). Emmanuel Moulin says France can still reassure bond investors despite ‘serious and worrying’ market moves in recent days Central banks and macro: Trump eases red diesel limits in attempt to quell fuel inflation (FT Markets). US president announces the move during a trip to the agricultural state of Nebraska Geopolitics and trade: How the US financed World War I using Charlie Chaplin and Girl Scouts (FT Markets). When the US entered the war in 1917, it faced a massive financial challenge: how to pay for its contribution?
